data.text:
Vikas @ Vicky Sunderlal Chhabra vs The State Of Maharashtra
on 26 August, 2024 
Author: Shivkumar Dige
Bench: Shivkumar Dige
 1
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 24 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1461 Of 2024
 Vikas @ Vicky Sunderlal Chhabra
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra
 ... 
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Shaikh Wajeed Ahmed
 App for Respondent / State : Mr. R. K. Ingole
 ...
 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
 Date : 26.08.2024 
PER COURT :
1. Heard the learned counsel for the applicant. 
2. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 05.09.2024. The learned A.P.P. waives service on behalf of respondent / State. 
3. In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with FIR No.0426 of 2024 registered with Basmath City Police Station, District Hingoli, for the offences punishable under Sections 123, 274,
275, 223, 3(5) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(2)(e), 30(2)(a),
59 of Food Safety and Standards Act,2006, he be released on executing personal bond of Rs.20,000/- with one surety in the like amount. The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when required and shall co- operate in the investigation. 
(SHIVKUMAR DIGE, J.) shp Vikas @ Vicky Sunderlal Chhabra vs The State Of Maharashtra on 26 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164424710/
